choice.basis: The dashboard legend shows pale yellow corresponds to the high end of the incidence scale (100) and dark burgundy/red corresponds to the low end (0). Texas (TX) is filled with pale yellow, indicating the highest displayed incidence among the three candidate states. Washington (WA) is dark burgundy (low incidence), and Colorado (CO) is gray, which is not part of the color scale and likely indicates missing data. Therefore, Texas is the correct jurisdiction for the highest-incidence follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing
